subject: BUG: input borders 1.5:1 fail WCAG 1.4.11 -- fix: add --border-input token
body:
BUG: Input borders fail WCAG 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast (need 3:1 for UI components)

Filed by: GD WCAG input audit
Priority: Medium

FINDING
shared/styles.css: .input-group input { border: 2px solid var(--border-default); }
- Light mode: --border-default #C8CCD8 on --bg-input #F8F9FC = 1.52:1 FAIL
- Arena dark: --border-default #2A3352 on --bg-input #1A2240 = 1.26:1 FAIL
WCAG 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast requires UI component borders to be 3:1 against adjacent colors.
Inputs are interactive, non-decorative -> no exemption.

FOCUS STATES (passing, do not change):
- Light focus: --accent-blue #1D42BA on #F8F9FC = 7.85:1 PASS
- Arena focus: --accent-blue #4A72E8 on #1A2240 = 3.61:1 PASS

FIX
Add a dedicated --border-input token for form elements (separate from --border-default which
controls card borders and decorative dividers -- those may be intentionally subtle).

In shared/styles.css :root (light):
  --border-input: #8A8FA5;   /* 3.04:1 on #F8F9FC -- WCAG 1.4.11 pass */

In shared/styles.css body.arena-mode (dark):
  --border-input: #6B748F;   /* 3.36:1 on #1A2240 -- WCAG 1.4.11 pass */

Then update:
  .input-group input, .input-group textarea, select {
    border: 2px solid var(--border-input);   /* was var(--border-default) */
  }

Do NOT change --border-default on cards/dividers -- those are decorative.
Only change interactive input borders.

ACCEPT CRITERIA
- Input/textarea borders visible against their background
- Input border contrast >= 3:1 against both bg-input and bg-page in both modes
- Focus ring unchanged (still uses --accent-blue variants)
- Card and divider borders unchanged
